items.title: Clay Jenkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 18, 2016
items.q: I got to ask Nancy Wilson about that one time because she was singing with the Clayton band and I had a moment

ctx.x: Oh I love that record. That’s a fantastic record. Oh. I got to ask Nancy Wilson about that one time because she was singing with the Clayton band and I had a moment, it was just a gift, I said I want to ask you about it. And she said, “yeah, people ask me about that all the time.” I said, “was that just so fun?” And she said, “oh, Zawinul and, what a band.” You know.

And the little arrangements they had behind her. I’m a big, basically both of them, Adderley nut. And I used to think when I would listen to their stuff a lot of times they would do a lot of stuff in unison. And I always thought boy if I was arranging that I would have done a harmony. Well that’s why they’re who they are. They sort of knew that. It sounded like one voice.
